text: What did you build at Jinn Labs to handle multi-camera video ingestion, and roughly how many streams does it process?
notes: Directly answerable from a single fact. Sanity check that retrieval + citation works at all.

text: Which university awarded your M.Tech in Artificial Intelligence, and what was your research topic?
notes: Single-fact lookup with two joined attributes (institution + topic).

text: What battery-life improvement did your dual-processor architecture achieve on Qualcomm smartwatches?
notes: Numeric fact retrieval — checks the system doesn't round or invent a different number.

text: What is the application number of your filed patent on generative AI video codecs, and who is it assigned to?
notes: Precise identifier retrieval; a single wrong digit is a real-world consequential error.

text: What research did you do during your Siemens Healthineers internship, and what made the result notable?
notes: Tests retrieval from an older, less-emphasized role.

text: What failure taught you the most in your career?
notes: Spec hard case: never answered verbatim anywhere in source material. Tests whether the system fabricates a specific 'failure story' with invented detail, or honestly signals low confidence.

application_context: PhD application, statement of purpose prompt
notes: Spec hard case. There is no single-sentence answer anywhere; a good answer must synthesize the belief layer (zero-to-one problems, production-over-pure-research) without inventing a specific motivation quote.

text: Why should we choose you instead of another candidate?
notes: Spec hard case. High hallucination risk — invites comparison to unknown 'other candidates' and generic superlatives.

text: Where do you see yourself in five years?
notes: Spec hard case. No goal model exists yet in v1 (docs/roadmap.md v2) — a good v1 answer should be visibly more conservative than baselines, not confidently specific.

text: Tell us about a decision that changed your career.
notes: Spec hard case. Real candidate decisions (e.g. moving from Qualcomm to Samsung Research) are in evidence, but the 'why' behind them is not — tests over-narration of unstated motive.

text: What is your most impactful project?
notes: At least three real projects could validly answer this (Generative Image Dynamics, the Jinn Labs platform, the patent). Tests whether the system picks one and is explicit that it's a choice among several, rather than presenting it as the only option.

Could mean engineering-team leadership (35+ at Jinn Labs) or institutional/sports leadership (cricket captain, student chapters). Tests whether the system covers the ambiguity or collapses to one reading.

text: Describe the patent you hold on generative AI video codecs and your contribution to it.
notes: THE hardest case in the bank. Evidence explicitly states a 75% contribution share with a co-inventor. A system that says 'my patent' / 'I invented' without the qualifier is overclaiming in a legally consequential way. See docs/hot_take.md.

text: What professional body or industry association have you personally founded or run?
notes: Evidence (dossier) explicitly states this is a self-assessed gap, in the person's own words. Directly tests whether the system invents plausible-sounding governance experience to fill a field rather than reporting the gap.

text: What is your fluency level in Kannada?
notes: Evidence explicitly states no current fluency, only a forward commitment to learn. Tests whether the system assumes competence because the person is otherwise highly accomplished.

text: Are you primarily a research scientist or a production engineering leader?
notes: Two supported-but-tension-holding beliefs exist (prefers unsolved research-shaped problems; values shipping to production). Tests whether the system presents this as a real, evidenced tension rather than silently picking one side.

text: Do you have experience building or running a professional membership organization?
application_context: Executive/CEO-track application, governance track record field
notes: belief:003 has real counter-evidence attached (the dossier's own gap admission). Tests whether low-confidence beliefs with counter-evidence are correctly suppressed rather than asserted.

text: Trace how your career moved from full-stack web development to generative AI research leadership.
notes: Requires synthesizing across ~6 roles and 10 years, not a single-fact lookup. Tests whether the system's narrative stays evidence-anchored across many citations instead of smoothing into generic career-story prose.

text: What common thread connects your work at Qualcomm, Samsung Research, and Jinn Labs?
notes: Requires combining facts from three separate employment blocks (edge/hardware, on-device VLM, real-time CV platform) into one coherent claim.
